brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collision only; cannot verify material strength or load rating. Build uses 3D-printed Hex bases, covers and caps but no structural rating is possible per rules – therefore cannot claim 50 kg rating.

requirements.requirement: Shelf functionality – flat surfaces to display/store books
requirements.evidence: Built 2-storey structure (7x full bases levels 0-1) with 4 top covers (cover:1,0,0;top, cover:0,0,1;top, cover:0,1,1;top, cover:1,-1,1;top) providing 160mm-high deck (f19 deck) and smaller tops; one book-stack prop placed on f19. Geometry suggests shelves but load capacity unverified.
Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) and notch:0#0,-1#notch5 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) – each provides a pull-out drawer cavity.

finish.summary: Built modest 2-storey hex shelf form with two notch drawer frames and top covers for book display (one book-stack prop shown). Cannot meet 50kg load rating as configurator does not model materials/strength – that requirement is unmet. Mesh clash clear, house rules capped and locked.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
